Why is my mind so loud at night?
Because throughout the entire day, you're constantly
dodging inputs, tasks, and noise.
When the room finally goes pitch black and quiet,
your brain suddenly gets the floor to process
everything it put on hold.
It's not that your mind hates you-it's just trying to
solve everything all at once because it finally has your
attention.
Btw, Dr. Breus has this distinction that really
clicks here:

The Mastery of Sleep by Dr. Michael Breus
